limitations: Package fixture path on macOS with Xcode 27.0; provenance toolchain fields match the separately measured hosted build, not a packaged fixture executable.
ProviderSession is an in-memory model; no File Provider domain, external editor, coordination, or entitlement was exercised.
Shared preview-builder tests do not prove Quick Look system extension dispatch.
Pre-start cancellation is deterministic; service interruption during a live preview or provider fetch is not tested. No physical-device or manual accessibility run.
Record date is evidence capture time; the package test output reports elapsed time but no UTC start time.
Duplicate refusal preserves the store but does not clean its staged review; this is recorded as existing behavior, not repaired in qualification.

outcome.detail: 23 tests in 5 suites passed. Matching edits advanced the appropriate revision; stale edits left the mirror unchanged. Original catalog bytes survived every mirror edit, eviction, and disconnect. Denied and pre-cancelled adoption committed no item; retry created once and duplicate adoption preserved state. Both samples previewed without a provider connection; hostile input and embedded markup were refused or escaped. Current behavior finding: refusing the duplicate leaves one staged review; the browser has no Close Review action.

steps: 23 tests in 5 suites, including 4 LAB-009-B qualification tests; fresh in-memory operation stores and temporary staging folders
